content.title: Single Decision Payoff | Prepare, Execute, Consequence, Return
content.summary: Establish one high-pressure threat, separate preparation from calibration, and commit to one irreversible decision. Show its attributable material consequence, then return to the responsible actor or outcome owner for a final confirmation lockup.

quick_start.input_format: Threat or failure status + responsible subject + preparatory action + calibration confirmation + one decisive action + visible consequences + subject or result final version locked
quick_start.recommended_input: Original alpine avalanche observation station, a section of unstable snow cornice hangs above the small research station in the blue-gray morning, the red measuring rod and the empty snow-bearing trough clearly prove the distance and scale; she rotates the brass tension ring until the two engraved lines are aligned and a solid green indicator point is stable, without triggering the main action; the front of the research station is safe and clear, the glaciologist lowers the anchor handle, confirms the stable slope and stands next to the hexagonal safety sign without text to maintain
required_anchors: Establish one dominant external threat or failure state before the actor commits.
Separate preparation from execution with one visible readiness action.
Execute one decisive action and show one directly attributable material consequence.
Return to the actor or outcome owner and hold a final lockup after the consequence.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: Establish one high-pressure threat, separate preparation from calibration, and commit to one irreversible decision. Show its attributable material consequence, then return to the responsible actor or outcome owner for a final confirmation lockup.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Establish one dominant external threat, isolate a responsible actor through a dedicated preparation phase, make the decision legible through a visible calibration or commitment cue, execute exactly one decisive action, show its material consequence, then return to the responsible actor or outcome owner before a final lockup. The mechanism depends on causal proof, not on combat, weapons or destruction.

invariants.rule: Establish one dominant external threat or failure state before the actor commits.
invariants.purpose: Gives the sequence one legible problem.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without an opening threat, preparation becomes generic spectacle.

invariants.rule: Separate preparation from execution with one visible readiness action.
invariants.ablation_failure: Immediate action removes the feeling of a deliberate decision.

invariants.rule: Insert one calibration, alignment or confirmation cue immediately before the decisive action.
invariants.purpose: Proves why the action occurs at that moment.
invariants.ablation_failure: A missing confirmation cue turns execution into an arbitrary cut.

invariants.rule: Execute one decisive action and show one directly attributable material consequence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Multiple unrelated actions or an unseen result dissolve accountability.

invariants.rule: Return to the actor or outcome owner and hold a final lockup after the consequence.
invariants.purpose: Confirms who owns the result and closes the arc.
invariants.ablation_failure: Ending only on the effect abandons the decision-maker and weakens closure.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: the source armored woman and shoulder launcher
the source ruined futuristic warzone and approaching aircraft
the source eye-targeting HUD and projectile-follow shot
the source aircraft fireball and burning skyline
the source SKYFALL title card and exact threat-preparation-launch-impact order

instantiations.concept: At an original alpine avalanche observatory, a glaciologist sees one unstable snow cornice above a research outpost, locks a resonant anchor into a marked ice plate, confirms one mechanical tension ring, releases a single low-frequency pulse and watches the cornice settle into a prepared catch basin before lowering the tool beside a wordless safety emblem.

instantiations.concept: In tactile stop-motion theatre maintenance, a stage engineer notices one suspended chandelier swinging toward a painted set, engages a hand brake, aligns a brass plumb marker, drops one counterweight and watches the chandelier settle precisely before returning beside the stable rigging diagram.
